name: performance-engineering
title: Performance Engineering
description: Optimise JavaScript, images, fonts, animations, 3D, lazy loading and resource delivery.
when_to_use: Every build (budget) and whenever measurements exceed targets.
instructions: Targets on emulated mid-range mobile: LCP <= 2.5s, CLS <= 0.1, no render-blocking scripts, total weight within budget.
Fix concretely: preload hero, set image dimensions, defer scripts, subset fonts, pause off-screen animation.
